stories.title: Riverside Community Day
stories.objective: Deliver a one-day community event for 120 guests within $6000, with step-free access, a wet-weather plan, volunteer coverage and reviewed communications.

gates.title: Choose Riverside Hall: $5400 total, step-free access, 120 seats; hold expires Friday.
Approve the invitation and accessibility wording before registrations open.

stories.brief: Venue shortlist: Riverside Hall seats 140 with step-free access; Garden Pavilion seats 160 but needs a $900 wet-weather tent; Library Studio seats 100 and cannot meet capacity. The hall plan totals $5400 with $600 contingency. A supplier revision increased the original catering quote by $240; the current plan already includes it. Two volunteer shifts still lack a first-aid lead.
monitors: Check registration totals and dietary requests every six hours
Review supplier quote changes and contingency exposure daily

stories.title: Home Energy Buying Guide
stories.objective: Produce a five-section buying guide covering heat pumps, insulation and solar; compare three household profiles across a 10-year horizon, retain source disagreements, and obtain editorial approval before sharing.

gates.title: Choose the electricity-price and heat-pump efficiency assumptions before the comparison is finalized.
Approve the five-section guide after evidence and limitations review.

stories.brief: The comparison uses three household profiles: a small flat using 6000 kWh of heat per year, a family home using 12000, and a detached home using 18000. Compare seasonal efficiency 2.5 / 3.0 / 3.5 and electricity tariffs $0.20 / $0.30 / $0.40 per kWh. Capital costs, climate, grants and discounting remain separate; operating-cost calculations alone are not payback estimates. Twelve source cards are a curated scenario inventory, with two unresolved assumptions retained for editorial review.
monitors: Check source revisions weekly before final publication
Review tariff assumptions and update sensitivity tables weekly
